Ecogenesis Farm & Training Center

A healthy land in a healthy environment means a healthy community — which in turn enjoys a healthy economy that can support and sustain life for everyone and everything that lives in the land.

Ecogenesis promotes an ecology-friendly way of farming and gardening. It follows the principles of Permaculture Design, which respects the dynamic relationship between the land, the farmer/gardener, and the community — a relationship based on mutual nurturance.

What Is Permaculture?

An innovative framework for sustainable living

Permaculture is a practical method of developing ecologically harmonious, efficient, and productive systems that can be used by anyone, anywhere. By thinking carefully about how we use resources — food, energy, shelter, and other needs — it's possible to get much more out of life by using less.

It is created by cooperating with nature and caring for the earth and its people — not a dogma, but an ecological design system that helps find solutions to problems facing us locally and globally.

"Permaculture, originally 'Permanent Agriculture,' has developed into a whole design philosophy — for some, a philosophy for life." — Emma Chapman

Featured Projects

Explore the farm, project by project

Seeded by GIFT

Sweet Potato Project

Being a "ground plant," the sweet potato makes a good covering for the soil, slowing evaporation and keeping precious water in the soil longer — vital for regenerating the dry, depleted mountainous lands of northern Philippines. As a ground cover, it also helps prevent soil erosion.

We thank GIFT for the seed money that started this project at Ecogenesis Farm.

See project photos
One Village At A Time

Eco-villages

Building a One Earth Community is not an overnight project but a long, labor-intensive work of relationship-building. This process moves from personal to social to ecological, giving birth to the Eco-village — founded, literally, from the ground up.

"The universe is not a collection of objects but a communion of subjects." — Thomas Berry

See project photos
Off-grid Power

Solar Energy

Thanks to the generous donation of the Arpin Group, Ecogenesis Center has an off-grid solar energy system. Solarius Energy, our local partner, sold and installed the system — including a solar-powered water pump.

See project photos
Learn By Doing

Farm & Training Center

Our training center hosts education and demonstration in permaculture farming and gardening, wellness, community organizing, leadership development, stewardship, and eco-conscious economy — a model backyard permaculture garden used for hands-on learning.
